greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu wuxuu u dhow yahay dhammaan kuwa isaga u yeera.
homily:
Waxaa jira sawir yar oo maskaxdayda ku soo dhacaya marka aan ka fikiro nolosha Benjamin Vo. Waxaan arkaa Ben oo fadhiya guriga, isagoo si taxaddar leh u dhisaya diyaarad model ah ama isagoo koodhka kumbuyuutarka u qoraya si uu u abuuro wax cusub. Wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu waxyaabaha yaryar u rogo waxyaabo waaweyn. Wuxuu ahaa qof aragtidiisu ay ka fogayd indhaha dadka kale, isagoo si qosol leh uga sheekayn jiray shirkaddiisa diyaaradaha ee uu ugu magac daray 'Con Chim Airlines'. Laakiin maanta, waxaan rabaa inaan idinla wadaago sirta ka dambaysa nolosha Ben: wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay in nolosha aan lagu cabbirin inta sano ee aad nooshahay, balse lagu cabbiro inta jacayl ee aad bixisay.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, Nebi Ishacyaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Rabbiga doondoona inta la heli karo, isaga u yeera inta uu u dhow yahay.' Ishacyaah wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in fikirka Ilaah uusan ahayn fikirka aadanaha. 'Sida samooyinku kor ugu xiggaan dhulka, sidaasay waddooyinkaygu uga sarreeyaan waddooyinkiinna.' Mararka qaarkood, markaan eegno nolosha Benjamin oo gaaban, waxaan is-weydiinnaa: 'Sidee tani u noqon kartaa waddada Ilaah?' Waxaan u baahannahay inaan xusuusanno in nolosha Ben aysan ahayn qalad, mana ahayn wax la seegay. Waxay ahayd hadiyad qaali ah oo Ilaah inoo soo diray, hadiyad aynu hadda dib ugu celinay gacmihiisa.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheekada ninka beerta leh ee shaqada u kireeyey dadka. Qaarkood waxay shaqeeyeen maalintii oo dhan, qaarkoodna waxay yimaadeen saacaddii ugu dambaysay. Laakiin ninkii beerta lahaa wuxuu siiyey dhammaantood isla mushaharka. Kuwii hore way ka cawdeen, laakiin ninkii wuxuu yidhi: 'Ma waxaad ka maseyrsan tahay inaan deeqsi ahay?' Halkan, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in boqortooyada Ilaah aysan ku shaqayn xisaabta aadanaha. Ilaah ma bixiyo nolosha si aan u tirinno saacadaha, wuxuu u bixiyaa si aan u buuxinno qalbiyada.

Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ay idinku noqdeen kuwo culus oo aamusnaan ka buuxdo. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben ee uu ku jiro dhoolacaddayntiisa quruxda badan, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Maxaynu seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii Alan, xanaanadii Thao—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa.

Bal xusuuso riyadii aad aragtay, Alan, markii Ben uu kuu sheegay: 'Ba, test-ka waan ka gudbay. Con tự thở được bình thường mà…' Ben wuxuu xor ka yahay culeyskii jirka. Wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon. Wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.'

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waxaan ogahay inaysan fududayn inaad lumiso saaxiibkaaga, walaalkaa, kii aad la wadaagaysay adduunka. Laakiin Ben wuxuu kaa doonayaa inaad sii waddo socodka, inaad noolaato adigoo geesinimo leh, adigoo xusuusanaya in xiriirka idinka dhexeeya uusan dhiman. 

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan rumeysanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jeclahay wax kasta, waxaanan rabaa inaan naftayda kuugu dhiibo. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramental-ka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horeyba u joogay, waxaanan naftayda gebi ahaanba kuu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhawro, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Nabad ku noqda Masiixa.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu ku soo dhaweeyo iftiinkiisa weligeed ah.
Qoysaska murugaysan iyo dhammaan kuwa culeyska wada, inuu Ilaah qalbigooda u dejiyo oo uu siiyo rajo iyo xoog.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Rabbiga doondoona inta la heli karo, isaga u yeera inta uu u dhow yahay. Kii shar wada ha ka tago waddadiisa, kii xunna ha ka tago fikirradiisa; ha u soo jeesto Rabbiga oo u naxariista; ha u soo jeesto Ilaaheenna, kaas oo ah mid deeqsi ah oo cafis badan. Waayo fikirradaydu ma aha fikirradiinna, waddooyinkayduna ma aha waddooyinkiinna, ayuu leeyahay Rabbigu. Sida samooyinku kor ugu xiggaan dhulka, sidaasay waddooyinkaygu uga sarreeyaan waddooyinkiinna, fikirradaydu na uga sarreeyaan fikirradiinna.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu u dhow yahay dhammaan kuwa isaga u yeera. Maalin walba waan ku ammaani doonaa, magacaagana waan ku ammaani doonaa weligii iyo weligiis. Rabbigu waa weyn yahay oo aad baa loo ammaanaa; weynaantiisuna waa mid aan la baari karin. Rabbigu waa naxariis iyo raxmad badan, wuu u gaabiyaa cadhada, waana naxariis badan yahay. Rabbigu waa u wanaagsan yahay dhammaan, naxariistiisuna waxay saaran tahay shuqulladiisa oo dhan. Rabbigu waa xaq dhammaan waddooyinkiisa, waana quduus shuqulladiisa oo dhan. Rabbigu wuxuu u dhow yahay dhammaan kuwa isaga u yeera, kuwa isaga u yeera runta.

readings.label: Akhriska Labaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal: Masiixa waxaa lagu weynayn doonaa jidhkayga, ha ahaato nolosha ama dhimashada. Waayo aniga nolosha waa Masiixa, dhimashaduna waa faa'iido. Haddii aan sii noolaado, taasi waa shaqo midho dhal ah aniga. Mana aqaan mid aan dooran doono. Waxaan ku dhex jiraa labadaas. Waxaan rabaa inaan ka tago noloshan oo aan la joogo Masiixa, waayo taasi waa mid aad uga wanaagsan. Laakiin inaan jidhka ku sii jiro ayaa aad ugu baahan faa'iidadiinna. Kaliya, u dhaqma si u qalma injiilka Masiixa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu xertiisii u sheegay maahmaahdan: 'Boqortooyada jannadu waxay u eg tahay nin beeralay ah oo aroor hore u baxay inuu shaqaale u kireeyo beertiisa. Markuu heshiis la galay mushaharkii caadiga ahaa, wuxuu u diray beertiisa. Sagaalkii subaxnimo markuu baxay, wuxuu arkay kuwo kale oo suuqa taagan, wuxuuna ku yidhi, 'Idinkuna beertayda taga, waxaanan idin siin doonaa wixii xaq ah.' Sidaasayna ku tageen. Wuxuu baxay mar kale duhurkii, iyo saddexdii galabnimo, oo wuxuu sameeyey si la mid ah. Shan saac oo galabnimo markuu baxay, wuxuu arkay kuwo kale oo taagan, wuxuuna ku yidhi, 'Maxaad halkan maalintii oo dhan u taagan tihiin?' Waxay ugu jawaabeen, 'Waayo qofna na kireynin.' Wuxuu ku yidhi, 'Idinkuna beertayda taga.' Galabkii markuu gaadhay, ninkii beerta lahaa wuxuu ku yidhi kormeeraha, 'U yeedh shaqaalaha oo sii mushaharkooda, adigoo ka bilaabaya kuwii ugu dambeeyey ilaa kuwii ugu horreeyey.' Markii kuwii shan saac yimid ay qaateen mushaharkii caadiga ahaa, kuwii horreeyey waxay u maleeyeen inay qaadan doonaan wax ka badan, laakiin iyaguna waxay heleen isla mushaharkii caadiga ahaa. Markaasay ka cawdeen ninkii beerta lahaa, iyagoo leh, 'Kuwii dambe waxay shaqeeyeen hal saac oo keliya, waxaadna ka dhigtay kuwo noo siman annaga oo dhibtii maalintii iyo kulaylkii u adkaystay.' Wuxuu mid ka mid ah ugu jawaabay, 'Saaxiibow, waxba kaama xadin. Miyeynan heshiis nala galin mushaharkii caadiga ahaa? Qaado wixiiaga oo tag. Maxaa dhacaya haddii aan rabo inaan kan dambe siiyo si la mid ah adiga? Mise xor uma ihi inaan lacagtayda u isticmaalo sidii aan rabo? Miyaad ka maseyrsan tahay inaan deeqsi ahay?' Sidaasay kuwii dambe u noqon doonaan kuwii horreeyey, kuwii horreeyeyna waxay noqon doonaan kuwii dambe.'

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
